title: msan makes `noundef` an ABI attribute, breaking Rust ABI promises
author: RalfJung
body_preview: LLVM function attributes are usually not ABI-relevant, any exception needs to be explicitly documented. msan breaks that by making `noundef` an ABI attribute. This is incompatible with Rust semantics where we want to consider `i32` and `MaybeUninit<i32>` to be ABI-compatible types (and we document as much).
